issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds 'Thật như Ta hằng sống' (Truly, as I live), which is not present in the Greek text ('ζω εγω'). While 'ζω' means 'I live', it is used here as a formulaic oath/expression of certainty, but the Vietnamese rendering 'hằng sống' (constantly living) slightly alters the grammatical function of the verb.

The Greek says 'εμοι καμψει' (will bow to me), but the Vietnamese says 'quỳ trước mặt Ta' (will kneel before my face/before me). While the meaning is similar, the Greek specifies bowing *to* Me, not specifically *before my face*.
